text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- According to latest unofficial results in Macedonia's local elections, the ruling Social Democratic Alliance (SDAM) is still the strongest party with 23 percent of the votes (around 234,000). Thirteen SDAM mayoral candidates have been elected . Voting for mayors in 76 municipalities out of a total of 124 will have to go into a second round.

- Opposition Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organisation - Democratic party for Macedonian National Unity (IMRO-DPMNY) is back on Macedonia's political stage. According to party sources it obtained only 20,000 votes less than the ruling SDAM. The party and its coalition partners have nine elected mayors and is contesting the remaining 76 municipalities facing runn-offs.

- Opposition candidate Risto Penov is first on the list of candidates for Skopje mayor with 39,713 votes, followed by the independent Ljupco Nikolovski Fufo with 39,622 votes and SDAM's Jovica Ugrinovski with 35,625 votes, the Skopje electoral commission said on Wednesday night.
- The Socialist Party in Skopje called for its members to vote for the SDAM's mayoral candidate in the second round.

- IMRO-DPMNY said "local elections have proved that early parliamentary elections are necessary this srping." The opposition has more than 180,000 votes and does not have a single representative in parliament while the ruling SDAM, with only 20,000 votes more, has total control over parliament. Therefore according to leader Ljupco Geogijevski this government is not legitimate and does not represent the citizens of Macedonia.

- The Liberal Party demands the resignation of general director of Macedoniian radio television Slobodan Trajkovski for not respecting equal representation of political parties during the election campaign.

- The radical nationalist Party of Democratic Prosperity of Albanians (PDPA) expressed satisfaction with its performance in the elections. "Even though the ruling PDP (the ethnic Albanian Party of Democratic Prosperity in coalition with the SDAM ) used all government instruments for manipulation, we are the absolute winners," it said. According to party sources PDPA is leading in most municipalities in western Macedonia.
